title: studio → pipelines: stop a batch for good
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.stop` (stream CMD) in the transaction that changes the batch; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`, n = the batch's command counter (submit = 1, +1 per later command). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines`, filter `cmd.pipeline.>`, one message at a time, in order). Studio has already cancelled the batch's open runs (their run_finished events follow). Pipelines starts no new rows, publishes every row that never started as `cancelled`, and `stopped` once every row is final.
